Inventory holds all shared release/context/transport/mount resources until review and cleanup. The one original DevOps publisher holds those same names. governance.scopeChanges: No speculative source implementation is assigned. A concrete tool/runtime defect returns to existing Scrum/Architect-advised Product Owner reconciliation for precise Developer ownership, regressions and exact-join E2E before execution; do not silently fix unowned source or repeat unsupported publication. No additional approval stage.
governance.safety: Preserve historical UNKNOWNs, held parents, rollback assets and unproven historical cleanup. Never replay uncertain effects, substitute parent/profile/project/region, use hidden local fallback, inspect/copy credentials, modify private settings, use standalone unaccepted launchers, submit provider evidence or change infrastructure/permissions under this replan. Use accepted fingerprint evidence first. Show actual device URL/code only if supported dedicated authentication requests it.
governance.stops: Original five consecutive reviewer-verified no-progress rounds remain binding without reset or productive-round cap. Engine endpoint absence or profile separation does not establish a user-only blocker. Real unsupported remedy/authority or uncertain effects stop at their precise boundary.

criticalPath.calculation: Source/ref handoff 40; original E2E phase duration unestimated; max(Linux 70, inventory 70) + ingress 100 + live exit/reconciliation 90 = 260 execution task-minutes, 300 including source/ref handoff. Original review/resource handoff included in each task; estimates are not limits or measured elapsed time.
criticalPath.minimalEdges: Source/ref handoff is a phase input to original E2E and then DevOps, not a full-code dependency added to readiness. Linux and inventory share the agreed exact-source interface but have disjoint mutable resources; neither waits on the other or ingress. Ingress joins their successful accepted handoffs; G1-G4 consumes actual both-role ingress. Scheduler phase/resource constraints are explicit and actual fan-out must be observed, not assumed.
criticalPath.downstream: RP-S3 keeps two-turn continuity, supported recovery, independent isolation, G5-G8 and final AC1-AC9 delivery; no task here waives those gates.

dispatch.instruction: Dispatch original dependency-ready work in the original phases. Parallelize independent Linux and inventory readiness when the original DevOps phase admits them; keep one original publisher. Do not redispatch accepted source/README/ownership work or start substitute agents.
